buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 5. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with NATIONAL ALUMINIUM COMPANY for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.)

The ‘Class-I local supplier’/ ‘Class II-local supplier’ as per this provision at the time of tender, biddi ng or solicitation shall indicate percentage of local content and provide self-certification that the it em offered meets the local content requirement for ‘Class-I local supplier’/ ‘Class II-local supplier’, as the case may be. Only Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per MII order dated 4.6.2020 will b e eligible to bid. Bidders shall also give details of the location(s) at which the local value addition is made. Declaration to be given in the format given in the Annexure I as attached under “Buyer upl oaded ATC document” of this bid. BIDDERS SHALL UPLOAD THE TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE SHEET (CUSTOM CATALOGUE UNDER B UYER SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT OF GEM BID) WITH DULY SIGNED DECLARATION TOWARDS CONFIRMATION OF THE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION.

MERE UPLOADING OF BUYER'S SPECIFICATION (TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE SHEET ATTACHE D UNDER “SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT”) AS COPY AND PASTING WILL NOT BE SUFFICIENT. (VI). Ø Bidder shall upload TECHNICAL SHEET (CUSTOM CATALOGUE) along with offer confir ming all points, failing which your offer may be liable for rejection. Ø Bidder shall also submit the complete Tender documents duly signed towards accept ance to tender’s terms & conditions. Ø Please certify that there is no deviation from the Tender conditions either technical o r commercial and I am agreeing to all the terms and conditions mentioned in the Te nder Specification. (VII). INCOME TAX CLAUSE TO BID: (i) For Supply Contracts / Purchase Orders / Supply portion of LSTK NALCO being buyer (under section 194Q inserted in the Income Tax Act, 1961 vide Finance Act 20 21) having total sales, gross receipts, or turnover from business above Rupees Ten Crores during t he last Financial year, will deduct TDS under section 194Q, w.e.f. 01.07.2021, at the prescribed rat e of 0.1% on the purchase value of any goods, aggregate of which is exceeding the threshold limit of RS. 50 Lakhs in a Financial year. Accordingly, Vendors/sellers are not to to collect tax at source under section 206C(1H) of the act w .e.f. 01.07.2021, in case provisions of section are applicable to them. The above is as per the current statute and is subject to modification(s) based on amendments / n otifications under Income Tax Act, 1961, from time to time. (ii) For Other Contracts / Orders Income Tax TDS, as applicable at the prevailing rate on the gross amount billed shall be deducted from the contractor’s bills. (VIII). Other detail conditions as below shall be confirmed a) Inspection: Inspection will be carried out at our stores NALCO, CPP and result shall be bi nding on seller. b) Bidder are requested to the please submit signed technical specification as per RFQ/NIT /scope of supply along the offers. Non submission of documents may lead to rejection o f your offers. c) Packaging: Weather proof and packaging with environment friendly material as suitable for the items capable of withstanding rough handling during transportation. d) Delivery Period:-The delivery period shall be as per GEM bid, e) Offer validity: The Offer validity shall be as per GEM bid. IF required, bidders shall be re quested to extend the bid validity. f) Payment terms:- As per GeM NIT. However, the payment of GST is subject to reflection of the party's invoice in GSTR 2A/ ANX-2 (GST new return) of NALCO. (IX). Bid must be accompanied with stated documents, whatever documents are parts of GeM bid/ NIT and confirmation to the terms stated in this GeM bid. Accordingly bidders shall quote.

(X). Offers form the bidders who have failed to execute earlier orders/contracts or in list of Black-li sted/suspended/banned vendors by Nalco/GeM will not be considered and not be acceptable. (XI) In case of any conflict between terms & conditions of GeM portal and against this tender, the t erms & conditions in this tender shall prevail. .
